100: Know that one who does not adhere to the simple meaning (*Peshat*) of Scripture damages the *Tiferet* of *Asiyah* (Action). One who does not bring evidence to support their understanding damages the *Tiferet* of *Yetzirah* (Formation). One who disregards the *Drash* (homiletic interpretation) of the Torah damages the *Tiferet* of *Beriah* (Creation). And one who neglects the *Sod* (mystical teachings) of the Torah damages the *Tiferet* of *Atzilut* (Emanation).

The mnemonic for this is *Pardes* (the orchard), representing the four levels of Torah interpretation: *Peshat*, *Remez* (hint), *Drash*, and *Sod*. One who merits to delve deeply into all of these levels attains the highest of spiritual elevations.
And this is what was previously explained.
—*MaHaRI’a* (Rabbi Isaac Aboab), may his memory be a blessing.
